title: Give your booking page a new look with skins!
summary: Booking pages get a new look with skins you can customize
body_markdown:
You asked and we at Venue delivered.


Tattoo artists can now personalize your booking page with skins. our designer Wayne dreamed up over 10 defaults (our fav is Y2K) and you can also choose your own fonts, backgrounds, and colors to your hearts content.
